headline: Lil Baby speaks on his relationship with Young Thug and Gunna, discourse around how people
body: Lil Baby speaks on his relationship with Young Thug and Gunna, discourse around how people thinks he “fell off” and more in a new interview with “I don’t have periods where I fell off, nothing has changed from now to Dead Fresh, the level I’m at if I put a hit or don’t put out hit it’s not gonna change for me. ” Baby’s new album ‘FRESH’ is set for release next week on Nov. 6. (: GETTY).

Lil Baby speaks on his relationship with Young Thug and Gunna, discourse around how people thinks he “fell off” and more in a new interview with @popcast 👀

“I don’t have periods where I fell off, nothing has changed from now to Dead Fresh, the level I’m at if I put a hit or don’t put out hit it’s not gonna change for me.”

Baby’s new album ‘FRESH’ is set for release next week on Nov. 6.
